name: iotaudit
description: Audit smart home devices on your own network: domains and countries they contact, unencrypted traffic, open ports, default logins, UPnP port forwards and an A-F grade per device, with a local HTML report. Runs locally, no telemetry.

tools.name: analyze_pcap
tools.description: Analyse a pcap of your own network: per-device destinations, plaintext vs TLS, A-F grade, safety verdict and optional HTML report.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Live-capture on an interface of a network you own (needs root, requires ownership confirmation).

tools.name: scan_device
tools.description: nmap open-port scan of one private LAN device you own.

tools.name: default_credential_check
tools.description: Opt-in, rate-limited check whether one device you own still accepts a well-known default login.

tools.name: diff_results
tools.description: Compare two saved iotaudit JSON audits and report new destinations, countries, ports and grade changes.

tools.name: upnp_port_mappings
tools.description: List the port forwards the LAN router opened via UPnP IGD (read-only).
